name: student-batch-mailer
description: Electron app for emailing student feedback via Outlook.

scripts.dist: rm -rf dist && electron-packager . "Student Batch Mailer" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out dist --overwrite --prune=true --asar --icon=build/icon.icns --app-bundle-id=nl.zuyd.student-batch-mailer --app-category-type=public.app-category.education --ignore='^/(build|dist|sample-data|sample-set|scripts|\.tmp-report|\.git|\.gitignore|README\.md|pnpm-lock\.yaml|pnpm-workspace\.yaml)($|/)' && cd dist && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent "Student Batch Mailer-darwin-arm64/Student Batch Mailer.app" "Student Batch Mailer-mac.zip"
